```{=html}
<style>
.w024 { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w024 .w024-cols { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w024 .w024-col { flex: 1 1 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }
.w024 .w024-item {
  padding: 5px 8px; border: 2px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  cursor: pointer; user-select: none;
}
.w024 .w024-term { font-weight: 700; text-align: center; }
.w024 .w024-def { font-size: 0.84rem; }
.w024 .w024-item.w024-picked { outline: 3px solid #d81e2e; outline-offset: 1px; }
.w024 .w024-item.w024-done {
  border-color: #2e7d32; opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; pointer-events: none;
}
.w024 .w024-item.w024-flash { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w024 .w024-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w024 button.w024-btn {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w024 .w024-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w024 .w024-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w024 .w024-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w024 .w024-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w024 .w024-expl {
  font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32;
  padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px;
}
</style>
<div class="w024 iw" id="w024">
  <div class="w024-cols">
    <div class="w024-col w024-terms" aria-label="terms"></div>
    <div class="w024-col w024-defs" aria-label="descriptions"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="w024-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w024-btn w024-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w024-btn w024-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w024-btn w024-sol iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w024-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w024-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w024-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    Region, availability zone and region pair are the physical geography: a geographic area of data centres, a physically separate data centre within it, and two regions linked for replication and disaster recovery. Management group, subscription and resource group are the administrative hierarchy Azure places above it. See <a href="#def-regions">the definition of region, availability zone and region pair</a> in <a href="#sec-02-traffic-geography">the section on traffic and geography</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w024');
  const termsCol = root.querySelector('.w024-terms');
  const defsCol = root.querySelector('.w024-defs');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w024-msg');
  const PAIRS = [
    ['Region', 'a geographic area containing one or more data centres'],
    ['Availability zone', 'a physically separate data centre within a region, with independent power, cooling and network'],
    ['Region pair', 'two regions linked for replication and disaster recovery'],
    ['Management group', 'applies policy and access across many subscriptions'],
    ['Subscription', 'a billing and isolation boundary'],
    ['Resource group', 'a lifecycle container for related resources']
  ];
  const DEF_ORDER = [4, 0, 5, 2, 1, 3]; // fixed scramble of the descriptions
  let pickedTerm = null, pickedDef = null;

  function clearMsg() { msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w024-msg iw-msg'; }
  function unpick() {
    if (pickedTerm) pickedTerm.classList.remove('w024-picked');
    if (pickedDef) pickedDef.classList.remove('w024-picked');
    pickedTerm = null; pickedDef = null;
  }
  function lockPair(t, d) {
    t.classList.remove('w024-picked'); d.classList.remove('w024-picked');
    t.classList.add('w024-done'); d.classList.add('w024-done');
  }
  function tryMatch() {
    if (!pickedTerm || !pickedDef) return;
    const t = pickedTerm, d = pickedDef;
    unpick(); clearMsg();
    if (t.dataset.k === d.dataset.k) { lockPair(t, d); }
    else {
      t.classList.add('w024-flash'); d.classList.add('w024-flash');
      setTimeout(() => { t.classList.remove('w024-flash'); d.classList.remove('w024-flash'); }, 450);
    }
  }
  function makeItem(text, k, isTerm) {
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'w024-item ' + (isTerm ? 'w024-term' : 'w024-def');
    el.textContent = text;
    el.dataset.k = k;
    el.addEventListener('click', () => {
      clearMsg();
      if (isTerm) {
        if (pickedTerm === el) { el.classList.remove('w024-picked'); pickedTerm = null; return; }
        if (pickedTerm) pickedTerm.classList.remove('w024-picked');
        pickedTerm = el; el.classList.add('w024-picked');
      } else {
        if (pickedDef === el) { el.classList.remove('w024-picked'); pickedDef = null; return; }
        if (pickedDef) pickedDef.classList.remove('w024-picked');
        pickedDef = el; el.classList.add('w024-picked');
      }
      tryMatch();
    });
    if (isTerm) {
      el.draggable = true;
      el.addEventListener('dragstart', e => e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', k));
    } else {
      el.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
      el.addEventListener('drop', e => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const t = termsCol.querySelector('.w024-item[data-k="' + e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain') + '"]');
        if (t && !t.classList.contains('w024-done') && !el.classList.contains('w024-done')) {
          unpick(); pickedTerm = t; pickedDef = el; tryMatch();
        }
      });
    }
    return el;
  }
  function build() {
    termsCol.textContent = ''; defsCol.textContent = '';
    PAIRS.forEach((p, i) => termsCol.appendChild(makeItem(p[0], String(i), true)));
    DEF_ORDER.forEach(i => defsCol.appendChild(makeItem(PAIRS[i][1], String(i), false)));
    unpick(); clearMsg();
  }
  root.querySelector('.w024-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const done = termsCol.querySelectorAll('.w024-done').length;
    if (done === PAIRS.length) { msg.textContent = '✓ All matched - physical geography below, administrative geography above.'; msg.className = 'w024-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else { msg.textContent = done + ' of ' + PAIRS.length + ' pairs matched - keep going (a wrong attempt flashes red).'; msg.className = 'w024-msg iw-msg'; }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w024-reset').addEventListener('click', () => { build(); root.querySelector('.w024-expl').hidden = true; });
  root.querySelector('.w024-sol').addEventListener('click', () => {
    unpick(); clearMsg();
    PAIRS.forEach((p, i) => {
      const t = termsCol.querySelector('.w024-item[data-k="' + i + '"]');
      const d = defsCol.querySelector('.w024-item[data-k="' + i + '"]');
      lockPair(t, d);
    });
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown - reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w024-msg iw-msg ok';
    root.querySelector('.w024-expl').hidden = false;
  });
  build();
})();
</script>
```
